assertions.assertion: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of palpitations, dizziness, and fatigue consistent with paroxysmal atrial fibrillation, sick sinus syndrome, and nonrheumatic mitral valve insufficiency.
The patient has paroxysmal atrial fibrillation.
The patient has sick sinus syndrome.
The patient has underlying nonrheumatic mitral valve insufficiency.
Paroxysmal atrial fibrillation is coded I48.0.
Sick sinus syndrome is coded I34.0.
Nonrheumatic mitral valve insufficiency is coded I49.5.
The arrhythmias are intermittent in nature.
There is a need to correlate symptoms with rhythm disturbances over an extended period.
Long-term continuous ECG monitoring is indicated to guide further management.
CPT 93247 represents long-term continuous electrocardiogram monitoring study.
Coverage cannot be denied on procedural grounds when the service is medically necessary to evaluate the patient's documented paroxysmal atrial fibrillation and sick sinus syndrome.
